namespace eval ds_ip_generation_flow {
    variable flow_id [flng::get_next_available_id -type flow]
    variable flow [flng::add_object -type flow_definition -number $flow_id -name ds_ip_generation]
    flng::set_property -object $flow -name identifier -value "IP Generation"
    flng::set_property -object $flow -name description -value "IP Generation"
    flng::set_property -object $flow -name storage_engine -value "dni"

    set taskname_list [ list \
        [list "ds_ipgenerate" "IP Generation"] \
        [list "hssi_support_logic_generation" "HSSI Support Logic Generation"]]

    set task_ids [dict create]
    foreach item $taskname_list {
        set task_name [lindex $item 0]
        set task_desc [lindex $item 1]
        variable task_obj [flng::get_objects -type task_definition -name $task_name]
        if {$task_obj == ""} {
            error "Error: unable to find $task_desc"
        } else {
            dict set task_ids $task_name $task_obj
            lappend task_list $task_obj
        }
    }

    flng::set_property -object $flow -name tasks -value $task_list
    flng::add_property -object $flow -name depends_on:[dict get $task_ids "ds_ipgenerate"] -value [list [dict get $task_ids "hssi_support_logic_generation"]]
	flng::add_property -object $flow -name parameters:rapid_recompile -value ""
}

namespace eval dni_straight_elaborate_to_qdb_task {

    proc eloborate_design {task_id} {
        package require ::quartus::dni
        package require ::quartus::synth

        variable sandbox [flng::get_property -name sandbox -object $task_id]
        variable design [dni::create_design -sandbox $sandbox]
        dni::set_current_sandbox -sandbox $sandbox
        dni::import_assignments -design $design
        synth::set_design -design $design
        synth::analyze_files
        synth::elaborate

        dni::extract_partition -use_qsf_setting

        variable sdc_file_path [dni_read_sdc_task::get_sdc_file_path $task_id]
        if {[file exists $sdc_file_path]} {
            set read_sdc_status [dni::read_sdc $sdc_file_path]
        }

        # Run sweep after all constraints are in place.
        synth::sweep -design $design

        synth::propagate_constraints -design $design
        dni::flatten -design $design
        synth::export_ddm_to_qdb -design $design -snapshot partitioned

        dni::save_design -design $design
        dni::close_design -design $design
        return 1
    }

    variable id [flng::get_next_available_id -type task_definition]
    variable task1 [flng::add_object -type task_definition -number $id -name "dni_straight_elaborate_to_qdb"]

    flng::set_property -object $task1 -name identifier -value "Straight Elaborate Design to QDB"
    flng::set_property -object $task1 -name description -value "Run elaborate design to QDB without intermediate checkpoints"
    flng::set_property -object $task1 -name tcl_command_template -value "dni_straight_elaborate_to_qdb_task::eloborate_design"
